steps: start the ordinary app with the offline evaluation data root (20 people) at the owner size
connect and open the evaluation Project
select the 担当者 cell of task 8 (one pointer action) and type "per": the candidate list opens while typing
press Down twice and Enter: the highlighted person commits the cell as one Undo step
apply that person to four tasks: select four 担当者 cells and press Ctrl+D
Undo once takes the four-task change back, leaving the single choice
add a second person after 「;」: F2, type the separator and take the first candidate
Escape closes the list first and a second Escape cancels the edit without changing the cell
Undo the remaining choice so the plan returns to its original state
